description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for a Linux-based embedded system, including methods for upgrading via SD boot, traversing slot UBI settings, copying configuration files, and checking image compatibility.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs system upgrade from an image file stored on SD boot media, copying kernel and root filesystem to appropriate device partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles UBI partition slot updating based on the current boot slot extracted from kernel command line.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to the boot device via SD.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to the appropriate location based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the image is compatible with the current hardware/board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing an upgrade, delegating to specific upgrade strategies based on the board.
